Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting the mailing of unsolicited credit cards.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to credit cards; and adding a new chapter to Title19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Credit card" means a card, plate, booklet, credit card number,credit card account number, or other identifying symbol, instrument, ordevice that can be used to pay for, or to obtain, credit, goods, orservices. (b) "Financial institution" means a bank, trust company, mutualsavings bank, savings and loan association, or credit union authorizedto do business and accept deposits in this state under state law. (2) A financial institution may not mail an unsolicited credit cardthat may be activated by a phone call to a prospective borrower. Thissection does not prohibit a financial institution from solicitingapplications for credit cards from a prospective borrower. Thissection does not prohibit a financial institution from mailing a creditcard to a prospective borrower who has asked in writing for the creditcard.
Section 1 of this act constitutes a newchapter in Title 19 RCW.
